title: Outside-slow ringless twin of nematic-fuelcell, third seed and a weaker dose: seed 1 gives 7 persistent splits (gen 3) vs 5 with the ring and 2 without; over seeds 0-2 the ringless twin matches the ring (32 vs 30 splits, ring-off 14)
summary: Completes 20261025T1713-c15-fuelcell-outslow-twin on the claim's third seed and adds a dose point. Seed 1, ringless (chi_s=0) with fuel diffusivity lowered 10x only outside the rods (dout 0.1): 7 persistent splits, generation 3, core fuel 0.456 (ringed world 5 splits, generation 3, core fuel 0.59; ring-off 2 splits, generation 1, 0.35). Seed 0 with a weaker 3.3x exterior slowdown (dout 0.3): 12 persistent splits, generation 2, core fuel 0.40 (dout 0.1: 13, gen 3, 0.43; ringed 14, gen 3; ring-off 5, gen 2). Over the claim's seeds 0-2, persistent splits are ringed 30, outside-slow 32, ring-off 14, so a less permeable bath reproduces the whole division gain of the self-made ring.

finding.operator: interface-gated fuel permeability made by a self-adsorbed surfactant ring
finding.control: ringless twin with fuel diffusivity lowered only outside the rods (dout 0.1 on seeds 0-2, 0.3 on seed 0)
finding.result: persistent splits seeds 0-2: ringed 14/5/11, outside-slow 13/7/12, ring-off 5/2/7; dout 0.3 seed 0: 12, gen 2

limits: Split counts vary 2-3x between seeds; seed 1 nucleates only 3 founders in every arm. Commands: WORLD_P='{"chis":0,"dout":0.1}' (or dout 0.3) python -m labkit.run world.py --seeds 1 (0).
